name: docs-skills
description: Route and maintain repository documentation, diagrams, and reference notes.

interface.longDescription: Route requested document work, audit repository documentation, update documents and diagrams, and curate reference notes.
defaultPrompt: Find the right location and workflow for this repository document.
Check whether the relevant repository documentation matches the current behavior.
Update the requested repository documentation using the current source of truth.
Create or update an editable diagram for the requested repository document.
Curate the requested reusable note in this repository's reference area.
